title: 법무부감찰위원회 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Composition of the Committee)
(1) The Committee shall consist of not fewer than seven and not more than 13 members, including one chairperson and one vice-chairperson.
(2) The Minister of Justice shall appoint or commission members from among public officials belonging to the Ministry of Justice or prosecutors' offices and external persons of high public esteem and extensive experience in the legal profession, academia, media, business, women's organizations, or civic organizations who are interested in the administration of justice, taking gender into account. At least two thirds of the members shall be commissioned from among external persons, and persons from the legal profession shall comprise no more than one half of all members. <Amended on April 28, 2020>
(3) The Minister of Justice shall commission the chairperson and vice-chairperson from among members who are not public officials after hearing the opinions of the members.
